skill.name: Devastator Drive · First Strike
skill.SpecificEffects:
After actively attacking, if spent <color=#F74848>2</color> or more Ammo, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> random Buff, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
Tactical Weapon Magazine Capacity <color=#F74848>+2</color>.
When actively attacking for the first time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

skill.name: Marauder Drive · Re-ATK
skill.SpecificEffects:
Melee Weapons can now attack airborne units.
ST Movement Type changes to Levitating, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
When re-attacking, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

skill.name: Rejuvenator Drive · Attack
skill.SpecificEffects:
At the start of action, repairs self <color=#F74848>1</color> time, equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Simultaneously repairs <color=#F74848>1</color> ally with the lowest HP percentage on the field equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. This effect cannot repair destroyed parts.
When in combat, enemy DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.

skill.name: Strider Drive · Hit
skill.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacking, if having moved at least <color=#F74848>5</color> tiles, gains <buf ID=1008062>[Absolute Dodge]</buf>. Removes after triggering. Can trigger again after an interval of <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When in combat, enemy Hit Rate <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

skill.name: Ammo Crate Drive · First Strike
skill.SpecificEffects:

When actively attacking for the first time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

skill.name: Mini Radar Drive · Attack
skill.SpecificEffects:
View Distance <color=#F74848>+1</color> in Arashi Fog Stages. Can use Code <skill ID=608011>[High Altitude Detection]</skill>. Enables the ST's adjacent <color=#F74848>2</color>-tile area to become a valid attack zone for ally Missile Launcher and Rocket Launcher attacks.
When in combat, enemy DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
